description: This file defines functions and types related to evaluating the state of gateway authentication surfaces, including configuration analysis and state creation for different authentication paths.

methods.name: formatAuthMode
methods.description: Formats the authentication mode string, defaulting to 'unset' if undefined.

methods.name: describeRemoteConfiguredSurface
methods.description: Generates a descriptive string based on remote configuration parts.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates a GatewayAuthSurfaceState object from given parameters.

methods.name: evaluateGatewayAuthSurfaceStates
methods.description: Main function that evaluates and returns the states of various gateway authentication surfaces based on configuration and environment.
